newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. December durable goods data, dealers said on Wednesday.
Durable goods figures for December, are forecast to show an increase of 1.2 percent compared with a 1.6 percent fall reported in November.

"Rates were quietly steady in the morning on some position adjustments. Everyone is waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the (U.S. December) durable goods data," a local dealer said.
"The figures have been built into the market and most people have squared their positions, so I don't think there will be much impact," he said.

In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday and Thursday/Friday rose 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, respectively. Week-fixed was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 and twelve-monhs unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
